messages:
jamal: Kicking off staged traffic shift for r-2026.03.23-rc4 -> 3 waves, target 15% (5% each). deploy id=20260323-rc4. Deploybot will ask for stop/go at each wave.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: wave1 (5%) rolling to eu-west. route-slice=eu-west, variant=r-2026.03.23-rc4. Logs: https://redwood.internal/deploy/20260323-rc4
Sre-jen: Observability ping — p50 okay but p99 tail in eu-west rising ~200ms -> 900ms over last 4m. snapshot: https://dash/reports/6188889999
maria: I'm seeing a spike in 502s on the embeddings endpoint in eu-west correlating with the tail latency. last10m +3.4% error rate.
zach: Can we slow progression? prefer wave2 at 2% and enable safety-latch. don't advance until we have p99 < 600ms.
ops-bot: safety-latch engaged by zach: max_wave_increment=2%, pause_on_p99>600ms, alert_channel=#eng-sre.
jamal: Pausing progression. Thinking: either soft rollback of eu-west slice or evict KV caches. Any quick diagnostics?
deploy-bot: Note: automated rollback scheduled in 30m for eu-west if human confirm not provided. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 6188889999-rollback`
Sre-jen: Hold on rollback. Let's capture KV/heap metrics first — suspect cache pressure causing backend 502s when model variant increases memory usage.
maria: Snapshot taken. kv_evictions spiked at same time as 502s. probable root cause signal.
zach: Vote: soft rollback + pin region to previous variant v2026-03-20 until we fix. Go? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
jamal: Vote recorded: go. I'll cancel further waves and pin EU to v2026-03-20. initiating cancel and pin now.
deploy-bot: Received cancel. Cancelling wave2 progression. Initiating soft rollback of eu-west slice to v2026-03-20. command: `/deploy rollback --region eu-west --target v2026-03-20 --type soft`
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress... status: 3 nodes drained -> 0 traffic on rc4 in eu-west.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed. eu-west serving v2026-03-20. health checks passing.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-123 opened (assigned: jamal, sre-jen). Incident notes: KV eviction spike -> embeddings 502s; action: pin region, adjust cache policy, add memory guardrails.
sre-jen: Follow-ups: create canary that isolates embedding pipeline, add quantization memory regression test in CI, and add a pre-flight KV pressure check to rollout automation.
maria: Updating release notes: "eu-west: rollback of r-2026.03.23-rc4 due to KV eviction causing embeddings 502s; pinned to v2026-03-20 while we investigate."
jamal: Thanks all. We'll keep the stop/go channel open. Will post postmortem stub in #postmortems once we have timeline.
